guarantee.q: How do you guarantee these results?
guarantee.a: We don't guarantee them in the magic sense. We produce them: every month we ship dozens of reels tested across variables (hook, voice, character, format). What works gets scaled. It's a process, not a lucky shot.

cost.q: How much does it cost to work with you?
cost.a: It depends on the type of partnership. A sponsorship on one of our existing communities starts at a contained budget; building a new page requires a dedicated monthly investment. The fastest way to find out is a call — we'll tell you if it makes sense before we talk numbers.

who.a: Consumer brands that have something to say and want to say it the way people actually want to listen. Food, tech, lifestyle, finance, retail. We don't work with everyone: first we talk, then we decide together.

why.q: Why should a brand invest in social content today?
why.a: Because attention lives in feeds, not in shop windows. A community on Instagram is a direct channel to your customer — no intermediaries, no CPMs to renegotiate every month. It costs to build, and it's worth it.

talent.q: Who's on camera? Do you provide talent?
talent.a: We only work with animated characters — no real talent, no human faces. We build the character from scratch and it becomes the brand's face. If you already have your own character, we animate it and bring it into the format.

ads.q: Do you handle organic content and paid advertising?
ads.a: Yes. The same content that performs organically becomes the creative base for ads. Same language, same character, lower cost per result.
